cues.en: Hi. I'm Pan, and this is my partner, Teller. You may have heard vaccination causes autism in one out of a hundred and ten children.
cues.zh: 嗨，我是Pan，这是我的搭档Teller。你们可能听说过，疫苗会导致110个孩子里有1个得自闭症。

cues.en: Fuck that. Total bullshit. It doesn't.
cues.zh: 扯淡。纯属胡说八道。根本不会。

cues.en: But let's imagine it does. We'll compare two groups of children. Teller's group gets no vaccinations.
cues.zh: 但咱们假设它会。我们来比较两组孩子。Teller那组不接种疫苗。

cues.en: My group does. I'll use this plexiglass
cues.zh: 我这组接种。我用这块有机玻璃

cues.en: Oh, oh, oh, that's bad. My vaccination wall knocked one of the children out of line. That's our one in a hundred and ten with autism.
cues.zh: 哦哦哦，糟了。我的疫苗墙把一个孩子撞出了队列。这就是那110个里得自闭症的1个。

cues.en: In the nineteen twenties, before the diphtheria vaccination was common, there were thirteen to fifteen thousand deaths a year from that disease. If you got it, your chances of dying were about forty percent.
cues.zh: 上世纪20年代，白喉疫苗还没普及的时候，每年有1万3到1万5千人死于这种病。一旦感染，死亡率大约是40%。

cues.en: just before the Salt Vaccine became common, there were about fifty eight thousand cases of polio. If you get unlucky, you might end up permanently disabled or dead.
cues.zh: 就在盐疫苗（索尔克疫苗）普及之前，小儿麻痹症约有5万8千例。运气不好的话，可能终身残疾甚至死亡。

cues.en: We have vaccinations against all of them. Which side do you want your child to stand on? So even if vaccination did cause autism, which it fucking doesn't,
cues.zh: 这些病我们都有疫苗。你想让你的孩子站在哪一边？所以就算疫苗真的导致自闭症——它他妈根本不会——
